title: Supply chain disruption on auto manufacturer stocks
research_question: Did a major semiconductor shortage announcement negatively affect auto manufacturer stocks, and do firms with higher chip dependency experience larger negative CARs?
data_description: Event study data for 80 auto-related stocks. Variables: stock_id, event_day (−10 to +10), ret, mkt_ret, beta. Requires both time-series CAR calculation and cross-sectional regression of CAR on chip-dependency measure. Market model: [−10,−2]. Event window [0,+5].
